title: 第二十九章   找寻帝女
content_zh:
玉京子又对墨非夜和芊芊两人嘱咐道：“这个过程千万不能随意打断，如果被打断，他就有可能迷失在梦境中，再也回不来。此处甚为隐蔽，外人很难找到，你们还是要小心一点。”

    “好嘞，你安心睡吧，别的教给本姑娘。”芊芊拍着胸脯保证道。

    玉京子点点头，拿起旁边的茶壶，倒一杯水喝下。刚躺到床上，就发出很均匀的呼吸声，明显是已经入睡。

    “这么快！”墨攻行找到一个舒服的姿势坐下，准备入梦。

    芊芊眼睛一亮，从怀中摸出一个瓷瓶，提起茶壶，将里面的液体倒了个精光。

    “高山流水，幽谷寒居。我去！！”墨攻行眼前，一座圆柱形的山峰，拔地而起直插入天，山峰岩壁光滑似刀削。

    山峰周围全都是一座座巨大的云山，将天日遮蔽得严严实实。还有更多的云，不断从四面八方涌来，不断堆积叠加成一座座云山。

    “葬云山”，墨攻行几乎没有思考，便认出了这种山。

    “山冻不流云，叶玉桃花浪，月殿桂子香”是神州大陆的三大奇景。

    排名第一的山冻不流云，就是指的葬云山景色。葬云山又名天柱山，处在世界的中心，为这个世界的最高处，传说它犹如一根柱子将天顶住，天才不会掉下来。

    天柱山下就是五色水的起源，被称为天下众河之母的“众姆河”。

    众姆河从悬圃直泻而下，流入冀州的弱水河中，再通过五色水流向四海。

    四海与幽冥海相连，在幽冥海的尽头，是不知有几千万丈的深渊，底部是终日燃烧火焰，永不会熄灭的沃焦。

    受到八风的影响，海水被沃焦蒸腾为云后，就会被吹到此处。在山峰上重新凝结为水，变为涓涓细流而下，聚集成“众姆河”。

    就这样周而复始，生生不息，滋养万物。

    葬云山虽然盛名在外，在九州的很多地方都可以看到。可对大多数人而言，只能远眺无法近观。

    原因也很简单，他处在昆仑上，也就是传说中的白玉京。那是夏公室和黄土古族的领地，其余八州的人，哪怕是诸侯，没有夏后传召，都没有资格上去。

    想要上去，除非你是天人境，天人境有一层意思，指修为上能与天合道，还有另外一层意思，就是能够去天上白玉京的人。

    “天上白玉京，十二楼五层。”

    “真的是梦里什么都有，真是会玩！”墨攻行心中，一万匹马在狂奔。

    他提前做好了思想准备，凶猛的怪兽，彪悍的武士，毒烟弥漫的山谷，他都想到过。没想到是葬云山，没想到玉京子说到高山流水，空谷寒居是葬云山。

    仰头望着葬云山上的一座座云山，墨攻行越来越觉得有可能。

    “旦为朝云，若我是云，我也会到这云山里去，这条蛇是不是脑袋有问题，居然做这种梦。你梦见个别的山不行？天上就一朵云不就行了。”

    抱怨归抱怨，可既然来了，墨攻行也不可能什么都不做。他试着爬了下山，山体陡峭光滑，他一丈都爬不到，就滑了下来。

    “你做梦一飞就上去了，你说要我怎么办？这上不去了，我只能用最土的办法了。”

    墨攻行说干就干，左腿横跨半步，仰头对着山顶云山，犀利的目光好似要穿透云层，笔直的身体，微微蹲下，两手微微捧成圆形，放在嘴边。

    洪钟般的声音响彻天地，将整座山峰都震得摇摇欲坠。

    “瑶姑娘，回家吃饭了！”

    “瑶姑娘，回家吃饭了！”

    厚重的云海，仿佛听到了墨攻行的招呼，狂风四起，云海翻腾，一座座云山被吹散。

    一只巨鸟出现在云端上方，它面朝南方，巨大的翅膀不知道延绵几万里，茫茫的看不到尽头。

    “我去，这蛇一副文盲样，居然连希有鸟都知道！”

    希有鸟下方的白云，从空中急坠而下，随着不断逼近，刚开始只有指甲头大小的白点，到最后都有小山那么大。

    “轰轰轰”落在地面摔得粉碎，激得到处都是。

    随着巨鸟扇动翅膀，狂风愈烈，掉落的云也越来越多。

    “我去，还能这样玩。”看到空中麻麻点点全是白点，墨攻行拔腿就跑。
content_en:
Yu Jingzi then told Mo Feiye and Qianqian: "This process must not be interrupted at will. If interrupted, he may get lost in the dream and never come back. This place is very hidden and difficult for outsiders to find. You still have to be careful."

    "Okay, you can sleep peacefully and let me teach you the rest." Qianqian promised, patting her chest.

    Yu Jingzi nodded, picked up the teapot next to her, poured a glass of water and drank it. As soon as he lay down on the bed, he made a very even breathing sound, obviously falling asleep.

    "So fast!" Mo Jiangxing found a comfortable position and sat down, preparing to fall asleep.

    Qianqian's eyes lit up, she took out a porcelain bottle from her arms, picked up the teapot, and poured out all the liquid inside.

    "High mountains and flowing water, deep valleys and cold dwellings. I'm going!!" In front of Mo Gongxing, a cylindrical mountain peak rises from the ground and reaches into the sky. The rock walls of the mountain are as smooth as a knife.

    The mountain peaks are surrounded by huge mountains of clouds, completely blocking the sun. There are more clouds coming from all directions, stacking up and forming mountains of clouds.

    "Burial Cloud Mountain", Mo Gengxing recognized this kind of mountain without even thinking about it.

    "The mountains are frozen but the clouds are not flowing, the jade leaves and peach blossoms are in the waves, and the moon palace is fragrant with cinnamon seeds" are the three wonders of the Chinese continent.

    The top-ranked mountain refers to the scenery of Burying Cloud Mountain. Burial Cloud Mountain, also known as Tianzhu Mountain, is located in the center of the world and is the highest point in the world. Legend has it that it is like a pillar holding up the sky, and geniuses will not fall.

    At the foot of Tianzhu Mountain is the origin of five-color water, the "Zhongmu River" known as the mother of all rivers in the world.

    The Zhongmu River flows straight down from Xuanpu, flows into the weak water river in Jizhou, and then flows to the four seas through the five-color water.

    The four seas are connected to the Netherworld Sea. At the end of the Netherworld Sea is an abyss tens of millions of feet long. At the bottom is Wojiao, which burns with flames all day long and will never go out.

    Affected by the eight winds, the sea water is evaporated into clouds and blown here. It condenses into water again on the mountain peak, turns into a trickle and flows down, and gathers into "Zhongmu River".

    In this way, it starts over and over, endlessly, nourishing all things.

    Although Burial Cloud Mountain is famous, it can be seen in many places in Kyushu. But for most people, they can only see from a distance but cannot see up close.

    The reason is also very simple. He is on Kunlun, which is the legendary Bai Yujing. That was the territory of Xia Gongshi and the ancient Loess Clan. People from the other eight states, even princes, were not qualified to go up there without being summoned by Empress Xia.

    If you want to go up, you must be in the realm of heaven and man. The realm of heaven and man has one meaning, which refers to those who can be in harmony with heaven in terms of cultivation. It also has another meaning, that is, those who can go to Baiyujing in the sky.

    "The white jade capital in the sky, the fifth floor of the twelfth floor."

    "You really have everything in your dream, you really know how to play!" In Mo Gongxing's mind, ten thousand horses were running wildly.

    He was mentally prepared in advance. He had thought about ferocious monsters, tough warriors, and valleys filled with poisonous smoke. Unexpectedly, it was Burying Cloud Mountain. Unexpectedly, when Yu Jingzi mentioned high mountains and flowing water, the empty valley and cold residence were Burying Cloud Mountain.

    Looking up at the cloud mountains on Burial Cloud Mountain, Mo Gongxing felt more and more that it was possible.

    "As a morning cloud, if I were a cloud, I would also go to this cloud mountain. Is there something wrong with this snake's head to have such a dream? Can't you dream about individual mountains? Just one cloud in the sky is enough."

    Complaints are complaints, but now that he's here, Mo Gongxing can't do nothing. He tried to climb down the mountain. The mountain was so steep and slippery that he couldn't climb even one foot, so he slipped down.

    "You went up as soon as you dreamed of flying. What do you want me to do? I can't go up here, so I can only use the most crude method."

    Mo Gongxing did as he said, taking half a step across with his left leg, raising his head to face the clouds on the top of the mountain, his sharp eyes seeming to penetrate the clouds. He straightened his body, squatted down slightly, cupped his hands into a round shape, and put them to his mouth.

    A loud bell-like sound resounded throughout the world, shaking the entire mountain peak to its core.

    "Miss Yao, go home for dinner!"

    "Miss Yao, go home for dinner!"

    The thick sea of clouds seemed to hear Mo Gongxing's greeting. The strong wind blew up, the sea of clouds rolled, and the cloud mountains were blown away.

    A giant bird appeared above the clouds. It faced south. Its huge wings stretched for tens of thousands of miles, and there was no end in sight.

    "Let me go, this snake looks like an illiterate, but he even knows about hope Youniao!"

    The white clouds below Xiyouniao plummeted from the sky. As they continued to approach, they were only white dots the size of a fingernail at first, but eventually became as big as a hill.

    "Boom, boom, boom" it fell to the ground and shattered into pieces, causing shock everywhere.

    As the giant bird flaps its wings, the wind becomes stronger and more and more clouds fall.

    "I'll go, I can still play like this." Seeing the white dots in the sky, Mo Gongxing ran away.
